sources.snippet: In this work, we reconceptualize autonomous driving as a generalized language problem and formulate the trajectory planning task as next waypoint prediction. We introduce Max-V1, a novel framework for one-stage end-to-end autonomous driving, named in tribute to the renowned Dutch racing driver Max Verstappen. sources.title: Max-V1: Lean Vision-Language Model for Driving
sources.snippet: The paper introduces Max-V1, a novel framework that reinterprets trajectory prediction for autonomous driving as an autoregressive sequence modeling task. It leverages a pretrained vision-language model for efficient end-to-end waypoint regression using a Gaussian-distributed formulation, bypassing the need for BEV representations. sources.title: ModelMax — Unified LLM Gateway
sources.snippet: One control plane for production AI apps ModelMax brings model access, cost control, and usage observability into one dashboard. Call models from multiple providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Track requests by date, model, tokens, and cost. Manage keys, topups, models, and usage history.

sources.title: Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real ...
sources.snippet: Elevenlabs' new Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models combine speed and accuracy. The v1 Max variant scores 98.8 percent on the Big Bench Audio benchmark with a .57-second response time. Elevenlabs says no model on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard is both faster and more accurate.
